summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for $1,000-per-note Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due October 19, 2029, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000 and S&P 500 indices. Coupons are contingent at a minimum $28 quarterly, with quarterly autocall starting April 16, 2027; pricing date is October 16, 2026 and issue date October 21, 2026. Notes are senior unsecured obligations issued under the Series A Medium-Term Notes program. This is a routine structured note takedown, not a special situation; note credit risk and index downside below threshold.
